competition_title: Google - The Gemma 4 Developer Agent Competition
submission_format: zip archive containing agent.yaml at root (submission.zip)
submission_budget: 12 hours aggregate limit across all tasks, inclusive of sandbox setup time, excluding patch validation
available_predefined_tools: read_file(filepath: str, start_line: int | None = None, end_line: int | None = None) -> str
edit_file(filepath: str, old_string: str, new_string: str, allow_multiple: bool = False) -> str
get_code_neighbors(node: str, edge_type: str | None = None, max_neighbors: int = 50) -> str
skill_constraints: Directories with SKILL.md manifest (name: <skill-name>); executed via run_skill_script in persistent Docker sandbox sharing filesystem with run_command; execution debited against central 12-hour budget; load_skill_resource for domain knowledge markdown inspection
adapter_format: PEFT LoRA .safetensors directories placed in adapters/<adapter_name>/ containing adapter_config.json and adapter_model.safetensors, referenced via adapter: <adapter_name> on any LlmAgent or AgentTool
